# Firefighting in Canada

> > The authoritative Canadian resource for firefighting industry news, equipment buyers guides, emergency management, and professional development.

Firefighting in Canada is a comprehensive industry publication and digital platform serving Canadian fire services with equipment directories, news briefs, training resources, and professional content. The site covers critical topics including codes and standards, emergency management, health and wellness, and career development for firefighters across the country.

## Key Topics

- Canadian firefighting
- Fire services
- Buyers Guide
- Emergency management
- Codes and standards
- Health and wellness
- Fire & EMS
- Equity, Diversity and Inclusion (EDI)
- Incident Command
- Equipment and apparatus
- Professional development
- Wildfire Week
- Firehall Bookstore
- Magazine + eNews
- Insight Exchange

## Core Resources

- [Buyers Guide](https://www.firefightingincanada.com/buyers-guide): Comprehensive buyers guide and directory for Canadian firefighting equipment
- [Digital Edition](https://www.firefightingincanada.com/digital-edition): Digital magazine edition with buyers guide and emergency management content
- [Features](https://www.firefightingincanada.com/features): Main features section and content directory for Fire Fighting in Canada
- [Videos](https://www.firefightingincanada.com/videos): Video library with firefighting resources and training materials

## News & Publications

- [Briefs Archive](https://www.firefightingincanada.com/briefs): Archive of fire service news briefs and industry publications
- [Firehall Bookstore eNews](https://www.firefightingincanada.com/firehall-bookstore-enews): eNews newsletter from Firehall Bookstore with industry updates
- [Blogs Archives](https://www.firefightingincanada.com/topic/blogs): Archive of blog posts and professional firefighting resources
- [Fire Fighting in Canada This Week](https://www.firefightingincanada.com/topic/fire-fighting-in-canada-this-week): Weekly digest archive with Canadian firefighting industry news

## Hot Topics & Specialty Content

- [Codes and Standards](https://www.firefightingincanada.com/topic/hot-topics/codes-and-standards): Archive of content on fire codes and regulatory compliance standards
- [Hot Topics](https://www.firefightingincanada.com/topic/hot-topics): Archive of hot topics covering firefighting news and emergency management
- [Emergency Management](https://www.firefightingincanada.com/topic/emergency-management): Archive of emergency management and EDI content for fire services
- [Health and Wellness](https://www.firefightingincanada.com/topic/hot-topics/health-and-wellness): Archive of firefighter health and wellness resources and information
- [Fire & EMS](https://www.firefightingincanada.com/topic/hot-topics/fire-ems): Archive of fire and EMS emergency services content for Canada

## Events & Networking

- [Firefighting in Canada Insight Exchange](https://www.firefightingincanada.com/virtual-events/firefighting-in-canada-insight-exchange): Virtual event: Insight Exchange on fire truck design for chiefs
- [Events Archive](https://www.firefightingincanada.com/events): Archive of past and upcoming industry events and networking

## Career Development

- [Employment and Hiring](https://www.firefightingincanada.com/topic/hot-topics/employment-and-hiring): Archive of firefighting careers, recruitment, and hiring resources
